alias.description: Sets an alias for multiple instances of the same input plugin.

buffer_chunk_size.description: Size of each buffer chunk allocated for HTTP requests (advanced users only).

buffer_max_size.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request buffer in KB, MB, or GB.

encode_profiles_as_log.description: Encode profiles received as text and ingest them in the logging pipeline.

http2.description: Enable HTTP/2 protocol support for the OpenTelemetry receiver.

http_server.max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent active HTTP connections.

http_server.workers.description: Number of HTTP listener worker threads.

http_server.ingress_queue_event_limit.description: Maximum number of deferred ingress queue entries.

http_server.ingress_queue_byte_limit.description: Maximum size of the deferred ingress queue.

listen.description: The network address to listen on.

log_level.description: Specifies the log level for this plugin.

log_suppress_interval.description: Suppresses log messages from this plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval.

logs_metadata_key.description: Key name to store OpenTelemetry logs metadata in the record.

mem_buf_limit.description: Set a memory buffer limit for the input plugin.

net.accept_timeout.description: Set maximum time allowed to establish an incoming connection.

net.accept_timeout_log_error.description: On client accept timeout, specify if it should log an error.

net.backlog.description: Set the backlog size for listening sockets.

net.io_timeout.description: Set maximum time a connection can stay idle.

net.share_port.description: Allow multiple plugins to bind to the same port.

oauth2.allowed_audience.description: Audience claim to enforce when validating incoming OAuth 2.0 JSON Web Token (JWT) tokens.

oauth2.allowed_clients.description: Authorized client_id or azp claim values.

oauth2.issuer.description: Expected issuer (iss) claim for OAuth 2.0 JWT validation.

oauth2.jwks_refresh_interval.description: How often in seconds to refresh the cached JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) keys from oauth2.jwks_url.

oauth2.jwks_url.description: JWKS endpoint URL used to fetch public keys for OAuth 2.0 JWT validation.

oauth2.validate.description: Enable OAuth 2.0 JWT validation for incoming requests.

port.description: The port for Fluent Bit to listen for incoming connections.

profiles_support.description: This is an experimental feature, feel free to test it but don't enable this in production environments.

routable.description: If set to true, the data generated by the plugin will be routable, meaning that it can be forwarded to other plugins or outputs.

storage.pause_on_chunks_overlimit.description: Enable pausing on an input when they reach their chunks limit.

storage.type.description: Sets the storage type for this input, one of: filesystem, memory or memrb.

successful_response_code.description: Allows for setting a successful response code.

tag.description: Set a tag for the events generated by this input plugin.

tag_from_uri.description: If no explicit tag is set, the tag is created from the URI.

tag_key.description: Record accessor key to use for generating tags from incoming records.

thread.ring_buffer.capacity.description: Number of slots in the ring buffer for data entries when running in [threaded](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

thread.ring_buffer.window.description: Percentage threshold (1-100) of the ring buffer capacity at which a flush is triggered when running in [threaded](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

threaded.description: Enable [multithreading](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md) for this input to run in a separate dedicated thread.

tls.ca_file.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file.

tls.ca_path.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files.

tls.ciphers.description: Specify TLS ciphers up to TLSv1.2.

tls.key_file.description: Absolute path to private Key file.

tls.max_version.description: Specify the maximum version of TLS.

tls.min_version.description: Specify the minimum version of TLS.

tls.verify_hostname.description: Enable or disable to verify hostname.

tls.vhost.description: Hostname to be used for TLS SNI extension.

per_record_routing.description: When true, Fluent Bit evaluates route conditions for each record.

name.description: A unique identifier for the route.

default.description: Match records that did not match any earlier route.

op.description: Logical operator for combining route rules.

context.description: Location of the field used for route evaluation.

field.description: Field to evaluate, using Fluent Bit record accessor syntax.

op.description: Comparison operator applied to the selected field.

value.description: Value compared against the selected field. Arrays are valid for in and not_in.

rules.description: Routing rules to evaluate for this route.
